$comment: Modules plugin code may not import (SDK 2.0: plugins have no database access). The one list read by the host's bundle check (runtime/plugin-compatibility.ts), scripts/check-persistence-boundaries.mjs, apps/plugins/scripts/verify-packed-plugin.mjs and eslint.config.cjs. Each entry forbids the package and its subpaths; an entry ending in /* forbids every package of that scope. Plugin spec and test-fixture files may import the engines (to compare a schema); frameworks and host modules are forbidden everywhere.
